#### Purpose and mechanism:

+----------------+----------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------+
|                | **Why: purpose and explanation**                               | **How: mechanism**                                         |
+================+================================================================+============================================================+
| Skin           | (1)Thermostasis: control of blood flow and sweating            | Hypothalamic cutaneous SNS output                          |
|                |                                                                |                                                            |
|                | - Preserves enzyme rate and function                           | Response to heat:                                          |
|                | - ↓T: too slow, dysfunction                                    |                                                            |
|                | - ↑T: too fast, ↑MR, denaturing                                | - ↓SNS                                                     |
|                | - Preserves pH hence protein function                          | - Dilatation of AV anastomoses and precapillary sphincters |
|                |                                                                | - ↓Resistance → ↑skin blood flow and volume                |
|                | (2)Blood reservoir                                             | - ↑Radiation, convection, conduction, sweat production     |
|                |                                                                |                                                            |
|                |                                                                | Response to cold: opposite                                 |
+----------------+----------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------+
| Renal cortex   | High flow:                                                     | Low resistance:                                            |
|                |                                                                |                                                            |
|                | - Ensure high GFR                                              | - Short, wide renal arteries                               |
|                | - Fluid, electrolyte, acid-base regulation                     | - Branches ++                                              |
|                | - Selective reabsorption of water and solute                   | - Glomerular fenestrae → filtration                        |
+----------------+----------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------+
| Renal medulla  | Low flow:                                                      | - High efferent arteriolar tone                            |
|                |                                                                |                                                            |
|                | - Prevents washout of interstitium                             |                                                            |
+----------------+----------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------+
| Carotid bodies | - O~2~ supply only by dissolved O~2~                           | - Small size, short diffusion distance                     |
|                | - Allows PaO~2~ responsiveness                                 | - Location in large vessels (aortic and carotid)           |
|                | - Note unaffected by Hb-bound O~2~ hence anaemia, CO poisoning |                                                            |
+----------------+----------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------+
